glosses: material; stuff (the tangible substance that goes into the makeup of a physical object)

examples.text: Ela está coletando material para um livro.
examples.en: She is collecting material for a book.
I'm going to buy school supplies.

examples.text: Aqui está um exemplo do material que eu quero.
examples.en: Here's a sample of the material I want.

examples.text: Esse alfaiate sempre usa material muito bom.
examples.en: That tailor always uses very good material.
